WITH enc_eng AS (
    SELECT 
        e.enc_key,
        e.pat_ref,
        AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as avg_eng
    FROM encounters e
    JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON e.enc_key = tb.enc_ref
    WHERE tb.th_eng IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low')
    GROUP BY e.enc_key, e.pat_ref
),
enc_ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        enc_key,
        pat_ref,
        avg_eng,
        LAG(avg_eng) OVER (PARTITION BY pat_ref ORDER BY enc_key) as prev_avg_eng
    FROM enc_eng
),
eng_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        eo.enc_key,
        eo.avg_eng - eo.prev_avg_eng as eng_variation,
        eo.prev_avg_eng as prev_eng_score,
        eo.avg_eng as curr_eng_score
